## Summary

Describe the smallest behavior or architectural proof changed by this PR.

## Validation

- [ ] Build succeeds.
- [ ] Relevant automated tests/spikes pass.
- [ ] No secret or privileged credential is added to source, fixtures, logs, or model-visible context.
- [ ] Provider/framework SDK types remain outside Loren.Core where applicable.

## Progress synchronization

Check these whenever this PR changes a capability, milestone completion, ADR gate, validated dependency version, or next execution target:

- [ ] `docs/status.md` reflects the new authoritative project status.
- [ ] `README.md` (English) reflects the same current phase/gate/milestone.
- [ ] `README.vi.md` (Vietnamese) reflects the same current phase/gate/milestone.
- [ ] Relevant ADR is updated if a decision/evidence/status changed.
- [ ] Relevant master/version plan is updated if milestone scope/order/exit criteria changed.

If the PR does **not** change project progress, state why these progress files do not need changes.

## Gate check

- [ ] This PR does not bypass an existing decision/security gate.
- [ ] Any newly opened blocker or limitation is documented before merge.

> A milestone is not considered fully closed until implementation/tests and repository progress documentation agree.
